findings.quote: scratch paths long since reaped under the host scratch rule, named here as history only
findings.skill_statement: The section marks the two w8 /tmp paths as history by saying they were "reaped under the host scratch rule", but that agency does not hold: the host scratch rule the page names is the directive of 2026-10-25 (SKILL.md@C**:29), eleven days after the runs it is applied to (both notes are dated 2026-10-14, mutation-case-kagi-checklist.md:3 and mutation-case-kumitate-claims.md:3), and its text carries no /tmp reaping mandate at all - it fixes the scratch root ($HYAKU_SCRATCH/<lane>-r<round>/<sub>/), permits /tmp for files under 50 MB, and binds each seat to delete its own tree (SKILL.md@C**:29-32). What actually ages /tmp on this host is systemd-tmpfiles (`q /tmp 1777 root root 10d`, /usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/tmp.conf), which acts on 2026-10-14 trees by about 2026-10-24 - before the directive existed - so on that mechanism the reaping was not "under the host scratch rule"; and if a seat removed the trees after 2026-10-25 instead, the removal is one or two days old, not "long since". No fleet or lane file records the w8 scratch being reaped at all (the only mentions of /tmp/w8-tameshi-t81/ and /tmp/w8-t8-2-claims/ at C** are the notes' live-at-write references and the round-8 draft/report). The verifiable fact is narrower than the sentence: both directories are absent now (`ls -ld` -> No such file or directory).
